data.name: China Energy Engineering Corporation
data.description: China Energy Engineering Corporation (CEEC) is the developer of "CarbonBox", described as Asia's largest CO2 direct air capture device by capacity, which has completed reliability testing. CEEC itself is a large Chinese state-owned power and infrastructure EPC conglomerate; CarbonBox was co-developed by a CEEC subsidiary and Shanghai Jiao Tong University and can capture CO2 from air or from emission sources and output different concentrations of CO2. DAC is a small R&D side activity within a multi-billion-dollar engineering group, not the company's core business.
